AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: For every data set in the class, the MGHD is future-inextendible as a C0 (continuous-metric) Lorentzian manifold: it admits no isometric embedding into a larger spacetime whose metric extends continuously.

AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: For every data set in the class, the MGHD is future-inextendible as a C2 Lorentzian manifold with C2 metric solving the vacuum Einstein equations: it admits no isometric embedding into a larger spacetime of that regularity.

AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH.conclusion_text: For generic data in the class, the MGHD admits I+ and every future-inextendible causal geodesic contained in J-(I+) is complete; equivalently, the singularities that form are hidden behind an event horizon and no singularity is visible from I+.

AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: For every data set in the class, the MGHD admits a conformal completion with a complete future null infinity I+ (all null generators complete), and every future-inextendible causal geodesic contained in J-(I+) is complete. Visibility is defined by that condition: a singularity is visible from I+ iff some future-inextendible causal geodesic contained in J-(I+) is incomplete. This is a definition, not an asserted equivalence with any other formulation (review HF-06).

AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: no proper future extension of the MGHD in the C0 Lorentzian class (bare continuous metric) exists

AF-SCC-C2-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: no proper future extension of the MGHD in the C2 vacuum class exists

AF-WCC-SCALAR-SPH.conclusion_text: no future-incomplete causal geodesic visible from I+ (the spherical version of the WCC predicate)

AF-WCC-VAC-GEN.conclusion_text: AF at I+ and I+ complete and no future-incomplete causal geodesic visible from I+
